evidence: Reviewed semantic gate and identity chain as preconditions for comparable evidence.

evidence: The executable explicitly excludes timer noise, multiple children, loops, async I/O, fusion, workers, waits, sampling, and clock differences.
Product metrics and boundaries are attributed to named current documentation rather than generalized.
Local reproduction, mechanism test, production correlation, formal benchmark result, and causal intervention are labeled as different evidence strengths.

evidence: Repository verification passed one standard-library Python snippet with exact eleven-line stdout, empty stderr, zero exit status, and recorded Python 3.14.4 toolchain.

empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No live database plan/profile, data-changing query, client/network trace, hardware counter, cache reset, concurrency, lock/I/O/spill, production sample, profiler-overhead calibration, or standardized benchmark was executed.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed progression from falsifiable question and reproduction envelope through plans, row/byte flow, nested/parallel attribution, storage/memory/waits, end-to-end boundaries, profiler calibration, production statistics, causal iteration, privacy, and regression gates. Measurement, estimate, attribution, correlation, cause, and policy remain distinct.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed an operational workflow using semantic/plan identity, estimates/actuals/loops/widths, join/filter/aggregate/sort/exchange flows, self/inclusive/CPU/wall/critical path, buffers/temp/WAL/I/O, memory/spill, waits/locks/queues, serialization/network/client, parameters/cache/concurrency, overhead, distributions, privacy, canary, and rollback. Changes require predicted intermediate evidence and workload validation.

pedagogical_review.notes: The chapter begins with a falsifiable performance question, derives attribution boundaries, gives an executable double-counting counterexample, covers ten evidence tools/experiments, lists fourteen misconceptions, includes ten distinct worked examples, and progresses five exercises to an elite regression gate with complete answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, official-source, mathematical, executable-snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external database maintainer, performance researcher, statistician, operating-system/architecture, benchmark auditor, security/privacy, reliability/operations, or independent practitioner review is claimed. The chapter and finite model prove neither target-engine metric semantics beyond cited versions, causal diagnosis for any workload, valid time subtraction under arbitrary parallel/async/fused execution, accurate cache/I/O/wait/counter attribution, representative production behavior, safe profiling of sensitive systems, formal TPC compliance, certification, nor deployment fitness.
